summary: Iteration 3 — bug-fix verification round. All three reported bugs (BUG #1 multi-turn memory, BUG #2 SSE JSON framing, BUG #3 frontend audio overlap) are FIXED and verified end-to-end. Full Phase 2 regression suite (36/36) still green. Created /app/backend/tests/test_phase3_bugs.py with 4 new targeted tests; all pass.
critical_code_review_comments: routers/interviewer.py + routers/twin.py: initial_messages assembly correctly filters only role in ('user','assistant') with non-empty content — won't replay stale system turns. session_id=conversation_id is appropriate for SDK context preservation. Good.

SSE framing: `data: <json>

` with json.dumps({"text": ev.content}) is the correct fix — embedded newlines, backslashes, and braces are now escaped and survive split("

") on the client. Confirmed via end-to-end test consuming a 3-paragraph reply.

Error path: `event: error\ndata: {\"error\":...}` is well-formed. NOTE: errors raised BEFORE the stream starts (e.g. 404 unknown conversation_id) hit FastAPI's HTTPException path and return 404 — they do NOT come back as event:error in SSE. This is correct behavior (caller will see HTTP 404 on res.ok check in streamSSE).

Twin.jsx: 3 layers of audio-overlap defense — (a) speak button disabled while speakingIdx === i, (b) stopAudio() called at speak() entry which pauses+nulls prior audioRef, (c) component-unmount useEffect cleanup pauses audioRef. Live test confirmed only 1 Audio instance is created despite 2 rapid clicks (~150ms apart).

lib/api.js streamSSE: correctly parses JSON-encoded data lines, falls back to raw text if JSON.parse fails (backward-compat), distinguishes event:done vs event:error vs default text-delta events. Buffer split on \n\n with carry-over pop() of the trailing partial — correct.

context_for_next_testing_agent: All 3 reported bugs are verified fixed. Backend SSE format is now JSON-framed `data: {"text":"..."}\n\n`; if any future feature consumes SSE directly, parse data lines as JSON. The audio fix has 3 redundant safeguards (disabled button + stopAudio + unmount cleanup) — the disabled-state alone prevented the double Audio() instantiation in the live test. Phase 3 user voice_id is set to a real ElevenLabs voice; subsequent TTS calls will burn small credits if invoked.
rca of the issue:
Originally: (1) each /interviewer/message or /twin/message constructed LlmChat with NO initial_messages, so LLM had zero memory — fixed by replaying conv.messages on every turn. (2) SSE delta yielded raw text containing 
 which collides with SSE framing delimiter 

 — fixed by wrapping each delta in json.dumps({"text":...}). (3) Audio overlap: rapid speaker clicks each created new Audio() with no stop of prior; navigating away left audio playing — fixed via stopAudio() + useEffect cleanup.
